title: Pro Fit Club Dashboard
description: Full-stack fitness club management system with member tracking, class scheduling, and payment processing.
content_markdown:
# Pro Fit Club Dashboard

A dynamic dashboard designed for Pro Fit Club, a local gym, built as a freelance project.

## Features

- **Member Management**: Track memberships, attendance, and fitness progress
- **Class Scheduling**: Interactive calendar for booking group classes
- **Data Visualization**: Real-time analytics and reporting

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Svelte
- **Backend**: Django
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
